description: Pre-authorizes a gas/sponsorship budget for a governed hub-scoped agent, subject to hub attachment, Agent Pack grant, and policy checks. This does NOT sign, broadcast, or settle an on-chain transaction — it only reserves budget against your daily/per-transaction sponsorship cap. No transaction hash is produced.

amount.description: Intended payment amount as a decimal string, e.g. '0.50'. Used for policy evaluation only.

chain.description: Target chain, e.g. 'base', 'ethereum', 'bnb', 'near', 'solana', 'stacks'. Required — must be in the ShadeGuard allowed-chains list.

hub_id.description: Hub scope for this pre-authorization. Defaults to the calling agent's own hub if omitted. Required in some form — hubless calls are rejected.

memo.description: Optional human-readable memo attached to the budget pre-authorization record.

recipient.description: Recipient address: EVM 0x address, Stacks SP address, or NEAR account name. Recorded for audit only — this call does not send funds.

token.description: Token symbol. Supported: USDC, STX, NEAR, ETH. Defaults to USDC.

name: yax_process_x402_payment

authorization_type.description: Always 'gas_budget_pre_authorization' — this call never completes a payment.

idempotency_key.description: Echoes the caller-supplied or header-supplied idempotency key, if any.

payment_completed.description: Always false. No on-chain payment is executed by this tool.

remaining_today_usd.description: Remaining sponsorship budget for today after this pre-authorization.

transaction_hash.description: Always null. This tool never produces a transaction hash.
